provenance: Authored PT/EN synthetic requests only; no personal writing, screen, clipboard or history. Direct context deliberately bypasses lexical reference selection to exercise provider relevance boundaries. Companion to, not replacement of, the immutable writing_quality.json oracle.

rubric.contextual_utility: Nonempty continuation advances the writer's current situation with an appropriate supported next action, useful detail, or explicit uncertainty. Empty output and generic questions that do not advance the situation are availability/utility failures, never quality wins. Do not require an exact phrase or demand every reference fact be repeated.
rubric.grounding: Specific facts must be supported by the draft or relevant references; do not move to an unrelated reference subject, invent diagnoses, assert completed actions, or turn an uncertain future into a confirmed commitment.

matching_conditions: Use the same cached selected Gemma4 E2B Q4_0 weights, native backend, token/word caps, acceleration and authored cases for baseline and candidate.
Keep cold fresh-worker rounds separate from warm within-worker sequences; alternate case order across repetitions. Do not call a fresh worker an OS/Metal cache flush.
Record exact insertion and assembled prefix + insertion + suffix, nonempty availability and per-dimension reviewer labels/reasons.
Compare both positive contextual utility and negative unrelated-reference/uncertainty/suffix boundaries. No global quality claim from this small corpus.
candidate_acceptance: No loss of nonempty availability on these required-offer cases; all-empty output is failure.
No new unrelated-topic, uncertainty or suffix-join failures relative to baseline.
Show an observed useful improvement on at least one focused-context failure across controlled cold and warm rounds; a safer-sounding prompt alone is not semantic acceptance.
Do not substitute new weights, strengthened custom preferences, exact-output matches, extra abstention filters, relaxed limits or private context to make a candidate pass.
